dialogues.speaker: Words on the Lamp
dialogues.text: Mom's mood has been improving. She's been all frowns ever since we left Dad behind.

dialogues.speaker: Words on the Lamp
dialogues.text: Maybe it's because she found out that Dad is living just fine after the separation, but she isn't...

dialogues.speaker: Words on the Lamp
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's just a shame that the library's got so many books that aren't for loaning. I wonder if Mom's read these stories... Ah, if only she'd read them to me.
